item.title: Getting started
item.description:
Signing in

Open stage.eu.haltian.io. The sign-in page offers two ways in.

With your Haltian IoT account

Field Description
Organisation Your Haltian IoT organization. It is part of the credential, not a choice made after signing in
Email The email of your Haltian IoT account
Password Your account password. The eye icon shows the password while you type

Select Remember the organisation and email on this device to have them filled in next time, then select Sign in.

item.title: Rooms
item.description:
Overview

Rooms shows how meeting rooms, phone booths and other spaces are used and how their air is: which rooms were used, how much each was used, how many people each room held, and the CO₂, temperature and humidity in each room. A device is part of Rooms when it carries the keyword room or rooms in Haltian Studio.


The Rooms dashboard, with demo data

Who it helps

Person What they get
Workplace manager Which rooms stood empty and which were used most, to decide where more rooms, or fewer, are needed
Facility manager CO₂, temperature and humidity room by room, and how long each room spent at 900 ppm CO₂ or more
Office team Which rooms were used and how much, on the floor plan, and when the rooms are usually busy

Views

View What you see
Dashboard How many of the rooms were used in the period. The floor plan with each room as Used, Not used or No data, and the floor’s zones as named outlines. A card per room with its share of time in use. Tiles for Most rooms in use at once, Time in use and the most people seen. The occupied share by hour or by day, and the most and least used rooms
Time in use The share of time each room was in use, the least used room, the rooms never used, and the rooms under 80 % known. One bar per room, most used first
Patterns A weekday-by-hour grid of the in-use share for all rooms, with the busiest and the quietest hour
People The people count over time, for every room that counts people or for one room, and the highest count per hour or day
A room’s page Opened from a room’s card, its name in the ranking, or its bar in Time in use. Time in use, Most people and Median when in use, a timeline of the chosen day’s in-use and free periods, the room’s own weekly pattern, and its air quality
Air quality CO₂, temperature and humidity over the period, one line per room. The CO₂ chart has reference lines at 750 and 900 ppm, the WELL v2 ventilation levels. A By room table with the mean, the highest reading and the time at 900 ppm or more, TVOC included
Rooms Every device tagged room in the space, with where it is, its Last reading before midnight, its readiness (Ready, Partial or Absent) and when it was last seen
Export How a report is exported: the two formats, which reports can be exported, and that there are no scheduled or emailed reports. Each report exports itself from its own page
Settings Which devices are included, what makes a device ready, the space scope, and your office hours

All reports use the period bar and can be exported.

item.title: Desks
item.description:
Overview

Desks shows which desks were used, where they are on the floor plan, and how much each desk was used. It helps you see which desks nobody uses, when the office is busiest, and how many desks were in use at the same time. A device is part of Desks when it carries the keyword desk or desks in Haltian Studio.


The Desks dashboard, with demo data

Who it helps

Person What they get
Workplace or facility manager The share of time each desk was in use, the least used desk and the desks never used, to decide how many desks a floor needs
Space planner The busiest and quietest weekday hours across all desks, and the most desks in use at once, to plan desk sharing and office days
Office manager Which desks were used yesterday, on the floor plan, and how much of the time each was in use

Views

View What you see
Dashboard How many of the desks were used in the period. Tiles for Desks used, Utilisation, In use per working day and Most at once. The floor plan with each desk as Used, Not used or No data, and the floor’s zones as named outlines. Desks in use by hour or by day, the most and least used desks, and a card per desk
A desk’s day Opened from a desk’s card, its name in the ranking, or its bar in Utilisation. Time In use and Free, the First movement and In use until, and a timeline of the day’s in-use and free periods
Utilisation Average utilisation, Least used, Never used and Under 80 % known. One bar per desk, most used first
Patterns A weekday-by-hour grid across all desks, with Busiest hour and Quietest hour. A week or a month shows the pattern best
Desks Every device tagged desk in the space, with where it is, its Last reading before midnight, its readiness and when it was last seen
Settings Which devices count, the space scope, and the office hours, which you can edit here

On the floor plan, select a desk marker or a desk card to highlight the same desk in both. When desks sit on more than one floor, a tab per floor lets you switch between them.

item.title: Parking
item.description:
Overview

Parking shows how the car park was used. One sensor is one space. You see how full the car park was on average, how many spaces were still free at its busiest moment, when it fills, how long cars stay and which spaces are rarely used. A sensor is part of Parking when it carries the keyword parking in Haltian Studio.

Parking shows measured occupancy only: parking booking is not part of Haltian IoT.

item.title: People flow
item.description:
Overview

People flow shows how many people come in and go out through your entrances, and when. It reads the entries and exits that people counters report to Haltian IoT. You see the busiest hour and day, when people arrive and when most have left, and which entrance carries the traffic. Where a counter was silent for part of the period, the app says “at least” instead of guessing.

A device is part of People flow when it carries the keyword peopleflow, people flow, entrance or entryway in Haltian Studio, plural forms included, and counts entries and exits.

item.title: Outdoor
item.description:
Overview

Outdoor shows the conditions outside a site, as measured by its own sensors: what it was like outside over the period, how the period ran, and what that means for heating, frost and heat. It uses every sensor that carries the keyword outdoor or outdoors in Haltian Studio. A sensor that also detects occupancy, such as a Haltian RADAR in an outdoor parking space, adds how much of the time its space was taken.

item.title: Tracking
item.description:
Overview

Tracking shows where tagged equipment was in your building at the last midnight: the zone each item was in, where it was on the floor plan, and where it spent its time over a period. Tracked items are objects such as laptops, trolleys or shared tools. What to tag and how to name it is up to your organization. Tracking is for objects, not for people.

Tracking is off until you switch it on

Open the account menu at the top right and, under Apps, switch Tracking on. It then appears in the app switcher and on the landing page. See The account menu.
